name: Ethika
situation: A direct-to-consumer apparel brand could not absorb traffic spikes on its orders and shipping systems.
obstacle: A rewrite was off the table, because the store had to keep selling throughout.
decision: Refactored orders and shipping onto AWS Lambda and API Gateway, moved the storefront to a Vue SPA on S3 and CloudFront, and put CI/CD with Cypress end-to-end tests behind it.
result: Spike-tolerant infrastructure with automated deploys, and a React Native app running on the same backend.
visualAlt: Screenshot of the ethika.com storefront, the direct-to-consumer site whose orders, shipping and front end this work rebuilt.
